resources.title: FreeRTOS Kernel11.2.0 scheduler and stack observation source
resources.access: Version-tagged public primary source and retained private captures
resources.reason: Correct invented API names and separate cooperative execution, observed stack fill and proven bounds.
locators: tasks.c configUSE_PREEMPTION macros, lines67–109; task.h taskYIELD
tasks.c prvTaskCheckFreeStackSpace and uxTaskGetStackHighWaterMark, lines6364–6455; task.h high-water API contract
include/stack_macros.h overflow checks; task.h vApplicationStackOverflowHook declaration
task.h xTaskDelayUntil documentation and vTaskDelayUntil wrapper; tasks.c xTaskDelayUntil lines2366–2451

inspection.method: Read listed source bodies and header contracts; inspected tagged primary URLs
inspection.scope: Named scheduler macros, absolute-phase delay arithmetic, fill scan, stack-check macros and hook declaration only.
inspection.limits: No execution of FreeRTOS or board validation. Delay source does not establish general response-time/deadline theory. FreeRTOS is a comparison source, never a dependency of strict original exercises.
